texts.name: Gideon
texts.biography: Gideon has been born with the favour of gods and this is probably why he has grown so reckless. It was a surprise to many that he didn't grow into a zealous warrior, but he still seems to consider blades and arrows randomly breaking on his chest as a welcome boon.

specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill percentage.
specialty.name: Armorer
